description: This Kotlin source file defines the CheckoutViewModel class, which manages state and logic for a checkout screen in an Android e-commerce application. It handles form inputs, validation, simulated payment processing, order creation, and user interactions related to the checkout process.

classes.name: CheckoutViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing the state and logic for the checkout process, including form handling, payment simulation, order submission, and interaction with repositories.

methods.name: prefillEmailIfAvailable
methods.description: Prefills the email field with the user's active email if available.

methods.name: applyLastPaymentMethodIfAvailable
methods.description: Loads and applies the last used payment method from preferences.

methods.name: updateCustomerName
methods.description: Updates the customer name field.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates the email address field.

methods.name: updateAddressLine1
methods.description: Updates the address line 1 field.

methods.name: updateCity
methods.description: Updates the city field.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the state/province field.

methods.name: updatePostalCode
methods.description: Updates the postal code field.

methods.name: updateCountry
methods.description: Updates the country field.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates the optional note field.

methods.name: setMockPaymentSuccess
methods.description: Sets whether the simulated payment should succeed or fail.

methods.name: updatePaymentMethod
methods.description: Updates the selected payment method, optionally persisting it as the last used method.

methods.name: recomputeCanPlaceOrder
methods.description: Recomputes whether the order can be submitted based on current form state and cart contents.

methods.name: validatePaymentSection
methods.description: Validates the payment-related input fields based on selected payment method.

methods.name: updateCouponInput
methods.description: Updates the coupon input field.

methods.name: updateCardNumber
methods.description: Updates and formats the card number input, updates card brand and last4, validates payment section.

methods.name: updateExpiry
methods.description: Updates and formats the expiry date input, validates the expiry.

methods.name: updateCvc
methods.description: Updates the CVC input, ensuring correct length based on card brand, and validating.

methods.name: updateNameOnCard
methods.description: Updates the cardholder name input.

methods.name: updateZip
methods.description: Updates the ZIP/postal code for card, normalizing input.

methods.name: applyCouponFromCheckout
methods.description: Applies the coupon code entered by user.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes the currently applied coupon.

methods.name: addSavedCoupon
methods.description: Saves a coupon code to the saved list.

methods.name: removeSavedCoupon
methods.description: Removes a coupon code from the saved list.

methods.name: clearSavedCoupons
methods.description: Clears all saved coupons.

methods.name: isCouponSaved
methods.description: Checks if a coupon code is saved.

methods.name: clearSubmitError
methods.description: Resets any submission error state.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Validates the form, processes payment (simulated), creates order via API, handles success/failure, and clears cart on success.

methods.name: initialFormState
methods.description: Creates initial form state, preferring last used payment method if available.

methods.name: setForm
methods.description: Updates form state, saves to SavedStateHandle, clears error states, and recomputes order eligibility.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the form fields, returning any errors.

methods.name: runPaymentSimulation
methods.description: Simulates payment processing with delay; approves or declines based on mock settings.

methods.name: mapError
methods.description: Maps a Throwable error to a SubmitState.Error with user-friendly message.
